brief:
The Public Prosecutor's Office in Ramallah has ordered the detention of Mazen Al-Natshe, brother of businessman Tariq Al-Natshe, for 48 hours pending investigation, Shehab Wire reported. Local media sources said prosecutors have charged Al-Natshe with extortion-related offenses in connection with the case.

According to his lawyer, cited by the sources, the charges stem from allegations involving coercion. The 48-hour detention period is standard procedure as investigators work to establish the facts of the case and determine the extent of Al-Natshe's involvement in the alleged scheme.
